ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: reeve
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's fields and harvests. When another people asks the colony for goods, the reeve sees to it, and they think a little better of the colony when it is delivered in full.

duties.li: Everyone brings in 2% more from every harvest.
The reeve sows and harvests 10% faster, and gets 5% more from each plant.
Opens once the colony has four people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} means to walk the fields first thing and come back with a list.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the soil here is better than it looks, and means to prove it.
{PAWN_nameDef} has two plans for the planting order already, and is torn between them.
{PAWN_nameDef} will walk the fields at first light and have any blight cut out before it spreads.
{PAWN_nameDef} means to see that anything the other peoples ask of the colony is sent in full.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to know what each field is growing and when it will be ready.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} wants more sown while the season lasts, and the weeds kept down.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants every last crop brought in and stored before the cold settles.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises to walk the fields every morning and be the first to see a blight.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: peacemaker
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Settles quarrels between colonists before they turn into feuds: now and then steps in when two argue nearby, and sits two rivals down together to talk it out.

duties.li: Every rivalry between colonists cools a little each day.
Now and then the peacemaker sits the worst-feuding pair down together, and the rivalry eases a good deal.
The peacemaker is more persuasive (social impact up 10%) and a little less likely to have a mental break.
Opens once the colony has five people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} wants a quiet word with two different people before the week is out, and won't say who.
{PAWN_nameDef} says anyone with a grievance can come and talk at any time.
The first thing {PAWN_nameDef} wants to know is who isn't speaking to whom.
{PAWN_nameDef} plans to sit the colony's worst rivals down together and make them talk.
{PAWN_nameDef} says {PAWN_pronoun} will step in when an argument starts, before it turns into a fight.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants every quarrel brought to {PAWN_objective} while it is still small.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} names no names, but says the colony's quarrels have gone on long enough.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises an ear for anyone who is sore at someone, before it turns to shouting.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: keeper of days
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps the colony's calendar and customs, and leads the feasts and games of the colony's calendar days.

duties.li: Every council custom and calendar day the colony keeps leaves everyone a small good memory of a day done properly.
The keeper of days carries more weight in conversation (social impact up 8%).
Opens once the colony has six people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} plans to start a new page in the calendar.
{PAWN_nameDef} already knows how many days it is until the next one worth keeping.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to write down everyone's birthday.
{PAWN_nameDef} means to lead the games and the feast on every day the colony keeps.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants to make sure no day the colony keeps is forgotten.
{PAWN_nameDef} is already planning the next feast day.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} wants the colony's traditions kept properly, the way they were the first time.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises that no day the colony cares about will go by unmarked.

ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: herdmaster
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Looks after the colony's animals: the herd, the pens, the milking and the shearing. The herdmaster also minds pets while their people are away, and sits with anyone whose animal has died.

duties.li: Everyone gets 3% more milk and wool from the animals.
The herdmaster tames and trains animals more easily (5% likelier to succeed), and gets 8% more from milking and shearing.
Opens once the colony has six people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} goes straight out to the pens.
{PAWN_nameDef} means to learn the name of every animal in the colony.
{PAWN_nameDef} says the herd will be better looked after from now on.
{PAWN_nameDef} will mind everyone's pets while they are away from the colony.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants the milking and the shearing done on time, every time.
{PAWN_nameDef} says anyone who loses an animal can come and sit with {PAWN_objective}.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says the herd needs someone who knows every animal by name, as {PAWN_pronoun} does.
{PAWN_nameDef} wants the colony to keep animals worth keeping, and to keep them well.
